# Gabe Mariscal

> Creative designer and developer based in California's Central Valley. Builds premium websites, AI tools, and brands.

## What this is
Personal portfolio and professional site for Gabe Mariscal — a designer-developer who ships end-to-end: brand identity, UI/UX, frontend engineering, and deployment. Specializes in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Runs BetrNames, a domain investment portfolio.

## Services
- Web design and development (React, Next.js, Tailwind)
- Brand identity and visual systems
- AI-powered tools and applications
- Domain strategy and acquisition
